title: crataegus crus-galli var. exigua
intro: Crataegus crus-galli var. exigua, commonly known as Dwarf Cockspur Hawthorn, is a small shrub or tree species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Cockspur Hawthorn include vasodilation, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus crus-galli var. exigua include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
